solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Unexpected teacher is being nosy, reportedly

indicators.note: reportedly says the phrase is to be heard spoken rather than read as written

parts.note: a male teacher is addressed as SIR, and being nosy is PRIES, so the phrase says SIR PRIES

explanation.surface: Someone is startled to find a schoolmaster snooping into their affairs.
explanation.walkthrough: SIR PRIES, spoken quickly, sounds like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Used attributively, as in a party sprung on someone, the word describes something not expected.

clue.text: Vacated shop lacking refinement and left urban area

indicators.note: a vacated word has had its insides cleared out, leaving only its first and last letters

parts.note: crude, unpolished, raw

explanation.surface: A shopkeeper abandons premises in an unrefined district and leaves town.
explanation.definitionFit: Urban sprawl is the spread of a town's built-up area, so the word names a straggling built-up district.

clue.text: Break ranks, expecting charge; exclude some soldiers initially

indicators.note: initially asks for the opening letter of each of the six words before it

parts.words: ranks, expecting charge; exclude some soldiers

explanation.surface: An army unit breaks formation expecting an attack, and a few soldiers are left out.
explanation.definitionFit: A recess is a pause or interval in work or proceedings, as a school or parliament takes.

clue.text: It is used in court fraud

definitions.meaning: a racquet for tennis or squash, played on a court

explanation.surface: Something deceitful is being practised in a court of law.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the bat strung for tennis courts and a dishonest money-making scheme.

clue.text: Time limit for having one's attention held

parts.note: a spell is a period of time
a bound is a boundary or limit

explanation.surface: A deadline is imposed on keeping someone's attention.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone spellbound is enthralled, their attention captured as if by magic.

clue.text: Topic — dull, I hesitate to say

parts.note: matt describes a dull, unshiny finish
ER is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: A speaker admits, with some hesitation, that their subject is boring.
explanation.definitionFit: A matter is a subject or issue under consideration.

clue.text: Element opposed to non- English currency

parts.note: anti means against or opposed to

indicators.note: non- signals that the next item, English, is absent from the word

parts.note: money is currency

explanation.surface: Something stands against using foreign rather than English currency.
explanation.definitionFit: Antimony is a chemical element, the brittle metalloid with symbol Sb.

clue.text: Country lad in hat running

indicators.note: running, as a mixture or ink runs, tells us to rearrange the letters

explanation.surface: A boy wearing a hat dashes across the countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: Thailand is a nation of South-East Asia, formerly Siam.

clue.text: Green ton? Wrong scientific unit!

indicators.note: wrong suggests the letters are in the wrong order and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone objects that a 'green ton' is not a proper scientific measure.
explanation.definitionFit: The roentgen is an old unit of exposure to ionising radiation, named after the X-ray pioneer.

clue.text: Staple food cut short — revolutionary opens holy books? Movement hard to predict!

indicators.note: cut short means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: rice is a staple food

indicators.note: opens means the revolutionary splits the holy books and sits inside them

parts.note: OT is the Old Testament
CHE Guevara is the crossword's standard revolutionary

explanation.surface: A clumsy cook trims the rice while a radical opens the scriptures.
explanation.definitionFit: A ricochet is a rebound of a projectile off a surface, its path deflected unpredictably.

clue.text: Restricted by Lambeth: a nerve gas

indicators.note: restricted by means the letters are held within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A deadly nerve agent is confined to the London borough of Lambeth.
explanation.walkthrough: Lambeth is a borough of south London.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethane is a colourless hydrocarbon gas found in natural gas.

clue.text: Our group way before time missing answer — a blow

parts.note: our group is us, WE
ST is the abbreviation for street, a way

indicators.note: missing says the named letter is left out of the word

parts.note: early means ahead of time

explanation.surface: We were on our way ahead of time, but a missing answer was a setback.
explanation.definitionFit: A westerly is a wind from the west, and a blow is a crossword word for a wind or gale.

clue.text: Charm stubborn guy overwhelmed by thanks on return

indicators.note: overwhelmed by means the stubborn guy is enclosed by the thanks
on return means the word for thanks is read backwards

parts.note: TA is British slang for thanks
a mule is a stubborn person

explanation.surface: An obstinate man's charm collapses when he is showered with gratitude.
explanation.walkthrough: The everyday British 'ta' for thanks is the key; 'on return' turns it round before it wraps the stubborn animal.
explanation.definitionFit: An amulet is a charm or talisman worn to ward off evil.

clue.text: Reduce intensity after 1st of December: cease cooking in evening?

indicators.note: 1st of asks for the opening letter of the word that follows
cooking means the letters are worked over and rearranged

parts.note: late describes the later part of the day, in the evening

explanation.surface: A cook stops making food late in the evening from the start of December.
explanation.definitionFit: To de-escalate is to make a conflict or situation less intense.

clue.text: Control travel before Jules welcomes African party

indicators.note: before places the travel word ahead of the rest

parts.note: go means travel

indicators.note: welcomes means the author takes the party inside his name

parts.note: Jules Verne, the French novelist
ANC is the African National Congress

explanation.surface: Jules Verne, before travelling, hosts an African political gathering.
explanation.definitionFit: Governance is the act of governing, the exercise of control over a state or organisation.

clue.text: Bishop Dai coaches Shaun regularly

indicators.note: regularly asks for every other letter, starting with the first

explanation.surface: A Welsh churchman, Dai, trains someone called Shaun.
explanation.walkthrough: Dai is a typical Welsh name.
explanation.definitionFit: As a noun, a diocesan is the bishop in charge of a diocese.

clue.text: Model soldier dropped cutting remark, maladroit originally

parts.note: a para is a paratrooper, a soldier dropped by parachute
a dig is a sly cutting remark

indicators.note: originally asks for the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: A clumsy soldier lets slip a hurtful comment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dropped' looks like the soldier's action, but it belongs to PARA.
explanation.definitionFit: A paradigm is a model or typical pattern of something.

clue.text: Relating to star team, one from Madrid?

parts.note: a side is a team
Real Madrid, the football club, so REAL is one from Madrid

explanation.surface: A football star's team is Real Madrid.
explanation.definitionFit: Sidereal means of the stars, as in sidereal time measured against the fixed stars.

clue.text: Mainsail it's adapted for Naples usage?

indicators.note: adapted means the letters are altered into a new arrangement

parts.note: the possessive s adds no letter, leaving IT

explanation.surface: A sailing boat's mainsail is modified for use in Naples.
explanation.definitionFit: An Italianism is an expression or custom typical of Italy, of which Naples is one example city.

clue.text: Fine story featuring Greek

indicators.note: featuring means the letters appear within the words given

explanation.surface: A fine tale with a Greek character in it.
explanation.definitionFit: Nestor is the wise old Greek king of Pylos in Homer's Iliad.

clue.text: Wine lover disheartened nurse?

parts.note: a beau is a boyfriend or lover

indicators.note: disheartened means the heart, the middle letters, is removed, leaving the outer letters

explanation.surface: A wine-loving nurse loses heart.
explanation.definitionFit: Beaune is a Burgundy wine from the town of that name.

clue.text: Restrict free rambling around motorcycle races

indicators.note: around means the rearranged letters surround the races
rambling means the letters wander out of order

parts.note: TT is the Tourist Trophy, motorcycle races on the Isle of Man

explanation.surface: Free roaming is curtailed near the motorcycle racing circuit.
explanation.walkthrough: The TT races are held on the Isle of Man; 'rambling' scrambles the word free to wrap them.
explanation.definitionFit: To fetter is to shackle, hence to restrain or limit.

clue.text: Prince in cold alien house

indicators.note: in means the prince sits inside the other letters

parts.note: ET is the film alien
Prince Hal, Shakespeare's future Henry V

explanation.surface: A royal hides in a chilly, unfamiliar dwelling.
explanation.definitionFit: A chalet is a wooden house, especially in Alpine style.

clue.text: No aid in sight if this is used?

definitions.text: No aid in sight if this is used?

parts.words: No aid in sight if this is used?
parts.note: something viewed without telescope or glasses is seen unaided, so no aid is in the seeing

explanation.surface: No help is forthcoming when a certain thing is employed.
explanation.definitionFit: The naked eye is unaided vision, used without any optical instrument.

clue.text: Piece cut, small, as it happens, right!

parts.note: a live broadcast goes out as it happens

explanation.surface: Someone notes that the slice they cut, as it turns out, is small.
explanation.definitionFit: A sliver is a thin piece cut or broken off something.

clue.text: Aunt's tip: loose clothing

indicators.note: loose means the letters are set free and rearranged

explanation.surface: An aunt advises wearing baggy clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: A pantsuit is a woman's outfit of trousers and matching jacket, an item of clothing.

clue.text: Agile Northern Ireland doctor backed by the French

indicators.note: backed by puts the French article behind the doctor

parts.note: MB is a medical degree, Bachelor of Medicine
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A sprightly Ulster physician has French support.
explanation.definitionFit: Nimble means quick and light in movement, as an agile person is.

clue.text: Husband getting attention on the double? Well said!

indicators.note: on the double means the piece appears twice over

parts.note: to give ear is to pay attention

explanation.surface: A husband hurries to listen, and someone applauds.
explanation.definitionFit: The doubled exclamation is the cry of approval used in Parliament and meetings to endorse a speaker.
